recipe.title: Drowsy Orchestra
recipe.summary: Chalk words on walls: the wall behaves like the word (MELT, LOW, STILL) while a ten-second bell makes you pick a law and a clock-faced beast eats your minutes.
teaches: pickup of a loose prop as a verb (a word)
a beast driven by `every` rules and zone columns

tock.desc: the Tock: a clock-faced beast on four brass legs that eats a minute of your day

bell.desc: the hall bell that rings every ten seconds: a brass dome with a clapper

chalk_plinth.desc: a small slate plinth with a glowing ring where a word of chalk waits

cog.desc: a great brass cogwheel set in a wall, stopped mid-turn

objective.text: BELL! Pick a law: LEFT-CLICK Hush (slow Tock) | RIGHT-CLICK Loud (walls stay open) | CTRL Sleep (no Tock, words cost 2)
Press E on the orange MELT chalk: it is written on the wall and the wall melts. Walk through.
MELT: wall opens a while. LOW: wall stays, hop it. The bell rings every 10 s: pick a law.
Cross the orange band: the Tock eats a minute if it catches you. STILL freezes it.
Law HUSH: slow Tock, walls close fast. Reach the clock.
Law HUSH: slow Tock, walls close fast. MELT opens, LOW hops, STILL freezes.
Law LOUD: fast Tock, walls stay open. Reach the clock.
Law LOUD: fast Tock, walls stay open. MELT opens, LOW hops, STILL freezes.
Law SLEEP: no Tock, words cost 2. Reach the clock.
Law SLEEP: no Tock, words cost 2. MELT opens, LOW hops, STILL freezes.
Reach the stopped clock with the fewest words and the fewest minutes lost.

start.title: Drowsy Orchestra
start.text: The clockmaker stopped time. Walk to his stopped clock at the far end. Write words on the walls with chalk (E): the wall obeys the word. Fewer words, fewer lost minutes: a quieter run.

victory.title: The clock hears you
victory.text: {words} words written, {lost} minutes lost. Quieter next time?

default.title: The day is gone
default.text: The Tock ate five minutes. {words} words written.

rules.if: beast_on == 1 && still == 0 && law != 3 && px >= 0 && px == bi

sim.name: MELT written on wall 1 melts it, and you walk through
the melted wall closes again by itself
LOW leaves a hop-high wall that stays
bell rings after 10 s in chamber 2; left-click picks HUSH
win: MELT, LOW, then STILL freezes the Tock, LOW and hop the last wall
lose: stand in the Tock's path five times and the day is gone
